thread:
nora: Heads-up — PR #4923 is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4923. TL;DR: KV cache locking fixes, new batching config flag (platform), and Dockerfile hardening (infra + security). Need runtime + platform + infra + security approvals before I merge tomorrow EOD. pinging: @sam @li @arjun @elaine :wave:

sam: On it. I'll scan the locking changes and perf implications. ETA 2-3h.

li: Quick check — can you add a unit test that exercises the new config flag parsing? otherwise looks small.

nora: Added a unit test in the last commit (see second-to-last commit). Also expanded PR description to explain rollout plan. Pinging @arjun and @elaine specifically for the Dockerfile changes.

arjun: Quick question about the FHS path change in Dockerfile — you're moving data dir to /app/data. Is that required? could break some infra deploys that expect /var/lib/app. tagging @deploy-infra for visibility.

deploy-infra: Noted. If the path changes we need to update the kube volume mount in deploy-config. Can you add a migration step or fallback?

nora: Good point — I'll add a conditional in the entrypoint to mkdir -p /app/data if missing and keep a symlink to /var/lib/app for backwards compat. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: check-run started for PR #4923 (unit tests, integration, lint).

elaine: I'll review the Dockerfile hardening. Please add a short threat-model line in the PR description and avoid running as root in the container. Also call out any new capabilities.

nora: Updated PR description with threat model note. Dropped USER root and added non-root user in Dockerfile. Also removed CAP_NET_ADMIN usage. Pushed.

sam: Quick runtime review: locking changes in runtime/kv/lock_manager.go look fine overall but prefer RWMutex for the read paths to reduce contention. E.g., replace Lock() on read path with RLock(). Small patch suggested in review. Also add a micro-benchmark for the hot path if possible.

nora: Thanks — pushed the RWMutex change and added a small benchmark under runtime/kv/bench_lock_test.go.

arjun: Infra: I still worry about the path move — added an entrypoint diff that creates /app/data and symlinks /var/lib/app -> /app/data if /var/lib/app not present. Also adjusted the healthcheck to use /healthz. Ran local smoke tests, looks fine. I'll approve once CI is green.

ci-bot: CI results: unit tests ✅, lint ✅, integration ❌ (1 flaky test in integration/auth).

li: The flaky integration test is unrelated to this PR. Will retrigger.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered. All checks green ✅.

elaine: Security nit: entrypoint script sets directory perms to 700 for the app user — please change to 750 so tooling can read logs in debug scenarios. Otherwise security +1 once perms updated.

nora: Updated entrypoint perms to 750 and documented in the PR.

sam: Runtime LGTM — approving now.

arjun: Approved from infra after local smoke pass.

li: Approved from platform.

elaine: Security approved.

nora: :tada: Thanks everyone. I'll merge in ~30m to wait for any last-minute issues. @release-coordinator FYI for rollout monitoring.

release-coordinator: Noted — will monitor the first 2-hour rollout window and ping if anything anomalous shows up.
